description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmailQueueServiceTest' for testing the functionality of the 'EmailQueueService' class within the OrangeHRM core plugin. It includes setup, unit tests for methods like adding emails to the queue, sending emails, changing mail status, and processing pending mails, using mocks and fixtures.

classes.name: EmailQueueServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the EmailQueueService, including adding to the queue, sending mails, and handling pending mails, utilizing mock objects and fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of EmailQueueService and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getEmailQueueDao method returns an instance of EmailQueueDao.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Ensures that getEmailService method is called exactly once.

methods.name: testAddToQueue
methods.description: Tests adding an email to the queue, verifying the Mail object has correct subject, body, and recipient lists.

methods.name: testSendSingleMail
methods.description: Mocks EmailService to verify that all message setting and sending methods are invoked once when sending a single mail.

methods.name: testResetEmailService
methods.description: Checks the resetEmailService method's behavior by verifying setup calls on EmailService.

methods.name: testChangeMailStatus
methods.description: Tests changing the status of a Mail object to STARTED and SENT, verifying the status field and sentAt timestamp.

methods.name: testSendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Mocks the DAO to return multiple pending mail IDs and verifies that sendSingleMail is called for each.
